_comment: Which key feeds which action. Key names are Bevy's KeyCode names. Axes: z is back (W is negative). deadzone (0..1) and curve apply to analog sources only (the pad, the virtual-joystick mouse); keyboard keys are digital. The same key may serve several actions. mouse.ship_mode: "vjoy" (the mouse moves a virtual stick; ship_sensitivity is radians of stick offset per pixel) or "direct" (radians of turn per pixel).
